subject: Bulette
picture: A bulette bursts from dungeon earth. Copy this body: heavy land-shark with a curved plated back, a row of dorsal spines, pale underside, thick digging claws, wide toothy mouth, tiny eye. Four stout legs. Burst soil as large clods. Stone ceiling, rock walls. Hole shows dirt outlines, not a black void. Bold even black outlines on white, same look as locked I-01 and I-02. All-ages.
